content_sections.heading: TISS Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the TISS Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for TISS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 19-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the posts of Helpline Supervisor and Data Analysis Officer in the TISS Recruitment 2026. This offers a good opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What are the post names for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post names for TISS Recruitment 2026 are Helpline Supervisor and Data Analysis Officer. Candidates can apply for these specific roles based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for TISS Recruitment 2026 is 19 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for TISS Recruitment 2026 is Email. Interested candidates need to send their applications and required documents to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Helpline Supervisor and Data Analysis Officer posts?
faq.answer: The salary for Helpline Supervisor ranges from Rs 45,000/- to Rs 50,000/- per month, and for Data Analysis Officer, it is Rs 45,000/- per month. These are attractive contractual positions.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for these posts?
faq.answer: For Helpline Supervisor, a Master’s Degree in Psychology with relevant experience is required. For Data Analysis Officer, a Master’s Degree in Counselling or Clinical Psychology with experience is needed.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the TISS Recruitment 2026. This makes it accessible for all eligible candidates to apply.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for TISS Various Posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for TISS Various Posts primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and then called for an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions at TISS?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions at TISS is Contractual. These roles offer an opportunity to work with a reputed institution on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The job location for TISS Recruitment 2026 is Mumbai, Maharashtra. Candidates applying for these positions should be prepared to work in this city.
